purpose: Document independent city-specific registry discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access investigation.
assessment: Fresh English and Chinese searches identified the point as Xinxing District, Qitaihe, Heilongjiang and found the official provincial Tianditu portal. The local government site returned an empty reply. Current public portal configuration exposed basemap, imagery, administrative-boundary and parking-map services only; no anonymous cadastral feature service, schema, CRS, native parcel ID, or geometry response was found.
registryAssessment: Local registry custody is unresolved and therefore registryFound remains null. The official local-government domain was identified but not inspectable; the provincial geospatial portal is general geospatial infrastructure, not evidence of a local cadastral registry service.
